text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad! Listen to this! Today, 
Trainer-san, my idol City-san, and I went 
to a crazy stylish cafe together!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Gold City-san... How many times did I beg 
to buy magazines with her on the cover? 
She's pretty, cool, steadfast, and just so 
incredible."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give it everything I've got so I can 
become a proud and cool 'City Girl' just 
like City-san!"
